title: Why Your Vote Doesn't Count
summary: CGP Grey explains first-past-the-post voting and why it pushes elections toward two dominant parties. It is the first in his series on electoral systems.
why: HN's go-to explainer for why FPTP leads to a two-party system, linked in countless voting-reform and US politics threads.

quote.text: this CGP Grey video explains how a first-past-the-post voting system all-but-guarantees a two party system to emerge over time
